name: Permanent Residence

requirements.blocker_text: Resided lawfully in Botswana continuously for at least 5 years.
requirements.fix_path: Accumulate 5 years of continuous lawful residence in Botswana.

requirements.blocker_text: Good character and standing in society.
Sufficient financial means to support dependents.
Investors with documented financial contributions and employee records may apply with less than 5 years of residence; the exact reduced threshold was not disclosed by the source.

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years' continuous lawful residence
For employees: employer confirmation and housing proof
For investors: financial contribution and employee records

sources.title: gov.bw (Botswana government portal), Department of Immigration and Citizenship -- Permanent Residence Application: 5 years' continuous lawful residence, good character, significant contribution, sufficient means; investors may apply sooner; P3000 fee; 6-month processing; Form 21

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Botswana). Directly and fully sourced to gov.bw's own Permanent Residence Application page -- the strongest file in this build. Modeled as PUBLISHED since all hard requirements trace to this single tier-1 government source. Three applicant categories (immigrants/dependents/missionaries, employees, investors) are disclosed on the source page; only the standard residence-based route and the investor exception are modeled as separate requirement groups since the employee category's requirements (employer confirmation, housing proof) are a documentation variant of the same standard path rather than a distinct threshold. The investor exception's exact reduced residence period was not disclosed by the source and is left unquantified rather than guessed.
